instrument: Ordinance amending City Code Chapter 14: proof of PUC and ERCOT approvals for data center applications (Aug 11, 2026)
summary: Passed 10-1 on Aug 11, 2026: new data centers seeking to develop within city limits must provide proof of all permits and approvals required by the PUC and ERCOT in order to file for a development permit, at multiple stages of the process. Does not apply in the city's extraterritorial jurisdiction.

source.citation: Fort Worth Report; KERA; NBC 5; DCD; The Business Press (Aug 12-14, 2026)

notes: CONFLICT: NBC 5 reports proof of approval from the PUC or ERCOT; the Mayor's announcement, DCD and The Texan report PUC and ERCOT. Ordinance text not read.
confidence_note: Ordinance text not read; ETJ exemption per the Assistant City Manager as reported.
